verdict.rationale: Crossplane runs as a headless control plane inside a Kubernetes cluster and exposes declarative APIs that its docs say automated workflows and AI agents can act on. Its official CLI can render and test Composition Functions without a cluster, which suits CI, and installation is scriptable via Helm. Community users describe GitOps flows with Flux/ArgoCD, but there is no first-party CI integration guide. Missing for 10: documented CI pipeline integration (e.g., official CI examples or actions), explicit non-interactive auth/credential guidance for CI, and independent hands-on reports of running Crossplane in CI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
